readyGames.title: Helix Jump
readyGames.controls: Mouse Drag / A & D / Left & Right arrows to rotate the helix tower
readyGames.description: Exciting bouncing ball adventure through the helix tower labyrinth. Avoid red forbidden platforms and drop straight to the bottom!

readyGames.title: MR RACER - Car Racing
readyGames.controls: WASD / Arrow Keys to steer, accelerate and brake. Space for handbrake.
readyGames.description: High-speed highway racing thriller. Weave through dynamic traffic, race in multiple game modes, and upgrade supercars.

readyGames.title: Supreme Duelist Stickman 2
readyGames.controls: WASD / Joystick to move and attack with wild physics-based stickman weapons.
readyGames.description: Crazy physics stickman fighting game. Battle with swords, guns, shields, and magic abilities across destructive battlegrounds.

readyGames.title: Mad Grand Prix
readyGames.controls: WASD / Arrow keys to steer and accelerate. Space to drift.
readyGames.description: Intense open-wheel circuit racing. Compete against aggressive AI drivers across realistic Grand Prix racetracks.

readyGames.title: Crossy Road
readyGames.controls: Arrow keys / WASD / Spacebar to hop forward, back, left and right
readyGames.description: Why did the chicken cross the road? Dodge endless oncoming cars, trucks, trains, and rivers in this beloved voxel arcade classic.

readyGames.title: PolyTrack
readyGames.controls: WASD / Arrow keys to steer, accelerate and brake. R to restart.
readyGames.description: Fast-paced low-poly track racer with physics loops, custom track editor, and official built-in tracks.

readyGames.title: Death Run 3D
readyGames.controls: Arrow keys to dodge oncoming obstacles and survive the neon tunnel.
readyGames.description: Hyper-fast first-person reflex runner inside an endless neon tube with unpredictable moving obstacles.

readyGames.title: Tube Jumpers
readyGames.controls: W / I / Up Arrow to jump and flip forward to stay on the tube.
readyGames.description: Hilarious 1 to 4 player party game. Battle against waves, sharks, and balls to stay on your floating tube!

readyGames.title: Geometry Dash Lite
readyGames.controls: Spacebar or Left Click to jump and fly to the rhythm of the music.
readyGames.description: Rhythm-based action platformer. Jump, fly, and flip your way through dangerous passages and spiky obstacles with full soundtrack.

readyGames.title: Jetpack Joyride
readyGames.controls: Left Click / Spacebar to activate jetpack thrusters
readyGames.description: Barry Steakfries breaks into a secret lab to commandeer experimental jetpacks. Bullet-powered jetpacks, giant mechs, and endless obstacles!

readyGames.title: Drive Mad
readyGames.controls: W / D or Arrow Keys to accelerate, reverse and balance
readyGames.description: Drive a 4x4 truck across increasingly wild stunt tracks filled with bridges, jumps, and crazy obstacles without flipping over.

readyGames.title: Basket Bros
readyGames.controls: WASD / Arrow Keys to move, Space to shoot / steal / dunk
readyGames.description: Fast-paced arcade 1v1 basketball action with wild dunks, crazy powerups, custom character unlocks, and intense physics.

readyGames.title: Drift Boss
readyGames.controls: Spacebar or Click & Hold to drift right; release to steer left
readyGames.description: One-button endless 3D isometric drifting game. Navigate tight zigzag ramps and collect coins to unlock new vehicles.

readyGames.title: Stickman Hook
readyGames.controls: Spacebar or Left Click to cast grappling hook and swing
readyGames.description: Swing from grapple points like Spider-Man, build momentum through loop-de-loops, and perform acrobatic stunts to reach the finish line.

readyGames.title: Poor Bunny
readyGames.controls: P1: WASD / P2: Arrow Keys. Collect delicious carrots, dodge traps!
readyGames.description: Charming 1-player or local 2-player arcade game. Help the hungry rabbit gobble up carrots while dodging spikes, sawblades, and lasers.

readyGames.title: A Dark Room
readyGames.controls: Mouse Click to stoke the fire and manage resources
readyGames.description: The critically acclaimed minimalist text adventure. Light a fire in a cold room, build a village, craft supplies, and venture into the silent forest.

readyGames.title: Antimatter Dimensions
readyGames.controls: Mouse click to buy dimensions, tickspeed, and sacrifice
readyGames.description: A massive, deeply layered incremental game about watching mind-boggling numbers skyrocket past infinity into dimensional sacrifice and eternity.

readyGames.title: The Prestige Tree
readyGames.controls: Mouse click to unlock nodes and prestige layers
readyGames.description: Branching prestige tree incremental game. Unlock points, prestige, boosters, generators, and discover an ever-expanding web of mechanics.

readyGames.title: Raft Wars 2
readyGames.controls: Mouse aim and click to adjust projectile angle & power
readyGames.description: Simon and Paul return to reclaim their buried treasure after a water park is built right on top of it. Shoot tennis balls and rockets across the pool!

readyGames.title: Golf Orbit
readyGames.controls: Spacebar or Click to swing with maximum power
readyGames.description: Smash the golf ball into orbit and reach Mars! Upgrade strength, speed, and bounce in this addictive one-shot golf simulator.

readyGames.title: Slow Roads
readyGames.controls: WASD / Arrows to drive, Space to brake, Shift for boost, C for camera
readyGames.description: Endless procedural driving zen. Cruise through rolling hills, seasonal forests, mountain passes, and space vistas with dynamic lighting.

readyGames.title: Vex 10
readyGames.controls: WASD / Arrow keys to run, jump, wall-climb, and slide
readyGames.description: The latest chapter in the legendary Vex parkour platformer series. Avoid razor-sharp saws, laser traps, and solve precision timing puzzles.

readyGames.title: PokéRogue
readyGames.controls: Arrow keys to navigate, Z (A button), X (B button), C (Menu)
readyGames.description: A Pokémon fangame heavily inspired by roguelites. Battle endlessly across biomes, draft Pokémon teams, and accumulate permanent relics.

readyGames.title: SUPERHOT
readyGames.controls: WASD to move, Mouse to aim & shoot / throw weapons. Time moves only when you move!
readyGames.description: The groundbreaking time-bending first-person shooter where time only moves when you move. Dodge bullets in mid-air and take out enemies in stylish slow motion.

readyGames.title: House of Hazards
readyGames.controls: P1: A/D to walk, W to jump, S to crouch/grab. P2: J/L to walk, I to jump, K to crouch/grab. Activate traps with corresponding keys!
readyGames.description: Hilarious multiplayer party game. Complete ordinary daily tasks around the house while your opponents activate hazardous traps to stop you.

readyGames.title: Brotato
readyGames.controls: WASD / Arrow keys to move and dodge. Shooting is automated. Space / Enter for menus.
readyGames.description: Top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play a potato wielding up to 6 weapons at once to fight off waves of aliens until help arrives.

readyGames.title: 4x4 Chess
readyGames.controls: Mouse Click to select and move chess pieces
readyGames.description: Fast-paced micro-chess played on a 4x4 grid. Intense, compact tactical puzzles and rapid games with standard chess movement rules.

readyGames.title: Idle Loops
readyGames.controls: Mouse Click to queue actions and configure time loops
readyGames.description: Strategic time-loop RPG. Queue actions to train stats, explore dungeons, and master magic spells before your mana runs out and the loop resets.

incompleteGames.title: Kingdom Rush
incompleteGames.issue: ActionScript 3 (AVM2) site-locked preloader that Ruffle WebAssembly cannot execute.
incompleteGames.fix_advice: Requires unlocked / site-lock-free Flash SWF or an HTML5 port.
